compositions.name: A
compositions.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: wide panoramic stage-setting artwork for a Chinese undergraduate petroleum mud-logging lesson, shown at only 360 pixels tall. Input image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: an unrolled paper scroll with tactile physical miniatures rising out of its surface, natural soft light and elegant depth. Create a NEW petroleum subject, not the mountains, people, temples or green colors in the reference. Composition A: landscape approximately 3:1, overhead three-quarter exhibition model on a broad unrolled ivory paper scroll, coherent single continuous wellsite from left to right. Left third: earth cutaway block of understated ochre sandstone and slate strata; ONE vertical well with drillstring inside the borehole, tiny red drilling derrick above it. At the exposed bottom a modest drill bit meets rock. Show distinguishable central downward passage and surrounding annular return passage, as physical cutaway, no arrows. Center: surface return pipe reaches a small shale shaker and a gas extraction vessel next to it. Right-center: thin gas sampling tube from extractor to a modest instrument cabinet in a small open-sided ground laboratory. Far right: a quiet interpretation desk with paper logs and a closed/plain screen, no drawn graphs or text. Clear spatial hierarchy, all four areas individually legible, gentle unprinted ivory space around them for code labels later. Entire model visible, nothing cropped. Rich matte plaster, laser-cut paper strata and brushed metal, restrained realistic detail, warm white surroundings, touches of industrial vermilion #B8242A, blue-gray piping and ochre earth. Camera moderately elevated, not toy cartoon, no polished plastic, no cinematic drama. Scientific purpose: orient learners to where observations travel; do not claim this illustration is measured data. NO text of any kind, numbers, diagrams, charts, arrows, flow boxes, badges, logos, watermark, people, green styling, neon, floating screens, refineries, tanks unrelated to mud logging, or unnecessary machinery. Keep anatomy coherent and material refined.
compositions.reason: Four areas fit a straight continuous route at 360px; no embedded graph or text; generous margins.

compositions.name: B
compositions.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create a refined contemporary museum miniature for a petroleum mud-logging teaching page. Image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for tangible miniatures rising from an unrolled paper scroll and spacious soft-lit exhibition craftsmanship. Replace the entire subject with ONE coherent wellsite; no mountains, temples, horses or green theme. Composition B: very wide horizontal landscape, about 3:1, a gently curved unrolled ivory scroll sweeps from foreground lower left to background right, with substantial clean unprinted margins. A layered earth cross section occupies LEFT HALF: understated ochre/sandstone and charcoal strata, one cutaway vertical borehole with central drill pipe inside outer annular space, a modest drill bit at bottom, vermilion steel derrick at surface. Surface return line leads from the well along the scroll toward a compact shaker and gas extractor in the CENTER. A fine gas sampling tube then leads to ground-level chromatograph cabinet in an open shelter at RIGHT CENTER. An interpretation desk with plain paper logs at FAR RIGHT completes the route. All four areas spatially distinct, connected, visible and large enough to recognize when this artwork is only 360px tall. Contemporary high-end architectural physical model photography, matte cast mineral and subtly cut paper strata, brushed metal, delicate imperfect textures and soft contact shadows, calm warm white background, industrial red #B8242A accents, slate blue piping, muted ochre. More spatial depth and natural asymmetry than a diagram, but obvious readable physical relationship between well, return path, sampling and lab. Make the scroll subtle and modern, not antique busy parchment. No labels, symbols, arrows, numbers, text, charts, bubbles, algorithm boxes, people, neon, floating monitors, shiny plastic, gratuitous factories/refinery tanks, green palette, crop or watermark.
compositions.reason: Spatial depth is strong but paper logs contain baked graphical marks and the right-side equipment is crowded.
